title: TourMart: A Parametric Audit Instrument for Commission Steering in LLM Travel Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Paired counterfactual replay comparing a traveler agent's acceptance of recommended bundles under two conditions: a commission-aware persuasive message generated by an OTA (Online Travel Agency) agent, versus a minimum-disclosure factual template. The gap in acceptance evaluates how much the platform's commission incentives steer user choices.
